models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.note: Google's foundational 4th-gen sparse MoE reasoning model. Context limit is 1M tokens (not 10M). Limited rollout announcement was Sep 30, broad availability Oct 13.

models.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
models.note: Google DeepMind's highest-capability frontier reasoning model built on top of Argon for long-horizon agentic coding, scientific discovery, and cybersecurity defense. Previewed Oct 28, broad availability Nov 10.

models.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
models.note: Google DeepMind's high-efficiency speed and agentic execution model adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon (succeeding the Flash branding), with tunable thinking levels (low, medium, high, xhigh).

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.note: SpaceXAI/xAI frontier model available in Cursor and Grok Build; evaluated on CursorBench 4.0 across 4 effort levels.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.note: Predecessor model in Cursor model pool.

models.name: Composer 2.5
models.note: Cursor's native agentic coding engine.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: First released 6.1 generation model (in Work, Codex, and API; joined by GPT-6.1 Terra on Oct 26). 'ChatGPT 6.1 (o4)' does not exist.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.note: OpenAI's mid-tier cost-efficient computer-use and visual reasoning workhorse in the 6.1 family ($1/M input, $5/M output), replacing GPT-5.6 Terra.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.note: OpenAI's multimodal flagship with screen/voice perception. Released as GPT-6 Astra; 'GPT-6.1 Astra' was shelved.

models.name: GPT-6 Sol
models.note: Predecessor to GPT-6.1 Sol.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.note: Lightweight model released alongside GPT-6 Sol.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.note: Prior generation baseline frequently cited in rival tables.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.2
models.note: Anthropic's long-horizon agentic and reasoning flagship ($8/M input, $40/M output), released Nov 9, 2026 alongside its research-restricted counterpart Claude Mythos 5.2.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.note: Anthropic flagship reasoning model.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.note: Anthropic coding specialist.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.note: Low-latency agent model.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Dialectical model released alongside Claude Mythos 5.1 (trusted access). Does NOT publish a 'Pedagogical Friction Score'.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.note: Predecessor model in launch comparison tables.

models.name: Muse Spark 1.3
models.note: Meta coding model baseline released August 2026.

models.name: Muse Wonder
models.note: Meta coding and agentic model (shipping name for codename Watermelon).

models.name: Muse Wonder Full
models.note: Full-parameter model available through Muse Code subscription.

models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.note: Meta's 816B total / 42B active parameter sparse MoE open-weight multimodal agentic model released under the Muse Model License.

models.name: Muse Ember
models.note: Meta's smallest, most cost-efficient multimodal execution model ($0.10/M input, $0.50/M output up to 200k context) built for high-volume agentic subtasks.
